title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust infrastructure, streamlining deployment processes, and ensuring high availability across our production environments. You will work closely with developers and QA to deliver scalable, secure, and cost-effective software solutions.

Required Qualifications

\* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in DevOps

\* Cloud Expertise: Hands-on production experience on (AWS)

\* Tools:

* Container Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
* IaC: Terraform, Ansible
* CI/CD: aws codepipeline, Jenkins
* Observability: cloudwatch, new relic, site 24\*7, nagious, promethues, grafana

\* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go

\* Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, ability to own incident response, and a passion for automation

Key Responsibilities

\* CI/CD Optimization: Design, implement, and optimize Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate code testing and deployment.

\* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using modern IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to ensure environment consistency.

\* Cloud & Container Management: Architect and manage containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes) across major cloud platforms.

\* (AWS)- ec2, ecr, eks, codepipeline, s3, ecs, cloudformation, waf, media, services, api-gateway cloudfront, sagemaker, bedrock, developer tools

\* Monitoring & Alerting: Configure comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting systems (e.g., cloudformation, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack,, new relic, site24) to maintain system health and fast incident resolution.

\* System Administration & Automation: Write and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to eliminate manual deployment and configuration tasks.

\* Security & Compliance: Integrate security best practices directly into the pipeline (DevSecOps), ensuring automated vulnerability scanning and compliance checks.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC?
* Expected CTC?
* Notice Period?
* This is an onsite opportunity in Delhi. Are you comfortable with the location ?
* We prefer immediate joiner for this role. Are you an immediate joiner ?

Work Location: In person

title: MLOps Lead
description:
Designation: MLOps Lead

Educational Qualification

* B.Tech / M.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or a related discipline.
* Certification in cloud DevOps or MLOps platforms (AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Expert, GCP Professional ML Engineer) is highly desirable.
* Contributions to MLOps or DevOps open-source projects are preferred.

Experience

* 7–10 years of experience in Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) or DevOps engineering.
* Minimum 4 years of experience building CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment in enterprise or government ecosystems.
* Proven experience with containerized applications and microservices architectures.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for AI/ML models across multiple environments.
* Establish model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback mechanisms to ensure system stability and traceability.
* Automate model training, testing, and serving workflows using containerized solutions.
* Define Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) templates for scalable AI/ML deployment across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to standardize model input/output formats and performance metrics.
* Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for deployed models to ensure high availability and accuracy over time.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI guidelines for deployment, including bias auditing and explainability tracking.

Technical Competencies

* MLOps Platforms: MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker Pipelines, GCP Vertex AI Pipelines for end-to-end ML workflow orchestration.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm charts, container registries, and microservices architecture for ML workloads.
* CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, with specialized ML pipeline integration and automated testing.
* Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible for reproducible ML infrastructure provisioning and management.
* Cloud Platforms: AWS (EKS, Lambda, ECR, S3), Azure (AKS, Container Registry, Blob Storage), GCP (GKE, Cloud Build, Cloud Storage).
* Model Serving: TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, Seldon, KServe, REST APIs, and real-time inference infrastructure.
* Programming Languages: Python for automation, Bash scripting, YAML for configuration management, and a basic understanding of Go/Java.
* Database & Storage: Feature stores (Feast, Tecton), model registries, data versioning (DVC), and distributed storage systems.
* Workflow Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Prefect, Argo Workflows for complex ML pipeline scheduling and dependency management.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: AI DevOps Engineer
description:
**Join DIRO: Pioneers in Deep Tech Innovation is hiring an AI-DevOps Engineer**

**Company Overview:**

DIRO is a trailblazing deep tech startup from the U.S., globally acclaimed with top-tier awards. We’re the #1 bank account verification platform, trusted by Fortune 500 brands, banks, and governments. Our bold mission? Build a new trust layer for the Internet by sourcing data straight from any website worldwide with user consent. We verify data from 44,000 banks, 9,000 utility providers, and 700 government sources across 195 countries in real-time. Learn more at www.diro.io.

**Our Mission:**

To provide the original source of truth from any global source, backed by DIRO’s innovation.

**Position:** AI DevOps Engineer  
**Location:** 66, Upper-Ground Floor, Okhla Industrial Estate, Phase - III, New Delhi - 110020

**Why Choose DIRO?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be at the cutting edge of infrastructure innovation, supporting the core of our state-of-the-art solutions.
* **Diverse and Inclusive Culture:** We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to bring your unique technical expertise to the table.
* **Professional Growth:** Thrive in a dynamic startup atmosphere where your personal and professional growth is a priority.
* **Advanced Technology:** Work with our patented technology that specializes in verifying original documents for identity verification and KYC/AML compliance.
* **Global Reach:** Collaborate with stakeholders worldwide and contribute to our global vision.

**About the Role:**  
As an AI-DevOps Engineer at DIRO, you will play a key role in enhancing our operational efficiency and ensuring the reliability of our services. You will work closely with developers, system operators, and IT teams to manage code releases and maintain a secure, scalable infrastructure. The role also involves leveraging AI tools and integrating intelligent automation solutions to optimize DevOps workflows, infrastructure provisioning, and system monitoring.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Write Terraform scripts using AI tools
* Implement and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP, utilizing services such as EC2, S3, VPC, Cloud Run and GKE.
* Design and manage networking solutions, including DNS, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls.
* Deploy and maintain containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation for automated provisioning.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automation tools like Github Actions.
* Develop scripts using Python for task automation and system management.
* Monitor and optimize system performance using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, New Relic, ELK Stack.
* Proactively troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues to maintain high service availability.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to drive infrastructure improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience in writing Terraform scripts integrated with AI-driven infrastructure tools such as Cursor AI or similar platforms.
* Proficient in using AI-enhanced DevOps tools and platforms for code generation, infrastructure automation, or pipeline optimization
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and associated services.
* Deep understanding of networking principles and security best practices.
* Expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Proficiency in CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions and scripting languages like Python.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and analytical approach.
* Proficient with security in tools like Scrut
* Expertise in managing security & CI/CD pipeline using Code ac/SonarQube

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Access to continuous learning opportunities and the latest DevOps practices.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) to support work-life balance.
* Health Insurance
* Complimentary meals provided.

**Ready to shape the future of infrastructure with us? Apply now and be part of DIRO's innovative journey!**

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

* DevOps: 1 year (Required)
* AI: 1 year (Required)

* Linux Essentials Certificate (Preferred)
* AWS Certification (Preferred)

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Sr. DevOps Engineer** with strong expertise in **Azure Cloud, AKS, Kubernetes, Istio, CI/CD, and GitOps** to design, implement, and manage scalable microservices platforms for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, automation, monitoring, deployment pipelines, and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments for microservices.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, and related tools.
* Implement GitOps practices using Helm, ArgoCD, and Terraform.
* Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Configure and support Istio Service Mesh for security, traffic management, and observability.
* Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and Shell Scripting.
* Monitor platform health using Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and Kiali.
* Support production environments, troubleshoot deployment issues, and ensure platform reliability.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Vendor teams for application deployments and enhancements.
* Drive performance tuning, scalability improvements, and infrastructure optimization.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 8+ years of DevOps experience.
* Strong expertise in Azure Cloud and AKS.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Istio.
* Experience with ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform (GitOps).
* Strong knowledge of Jenkins, GitLab CI, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong Linux Administration skills.
* Scripting experience in Python, Bash, and Shell.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, and OpenTelemetry.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale microservices architecture.

**Good to Have**

* Java development knowledge.
* Experience with Kafka, Redis, MySQL, Apigee, Akamai, and Palo Alto Firewall.
* FinOps and cloud cost optimization.
* Performance testing and tuning.
* Team leadership experience.

Pay: From ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Delhi
